documents.source_note: Historical English web transcription of the 1903 Benziger edition; individual translator unidentified. Encoding-only repair of 16 spans (16 intact reversals; 0 partial marker repairs), each corroborated by independent OCR of this printing. OCR word and source-date errors remain uncorrected; full print collation is outstanding. The web transcription heading prints May 4, 1897; the official work catalog dates the act May 9, 1897. One proven running-head prefix is excluded; one unreadable two-byte book numeral is mechanically recovered as vi from fresh independent OCR corroborated against original-print page images. All other selected bytes and separate historical note paragraphs are retained. These bounded repairs do not establish full print collation. Two malformed quotation tokens are additionally recovered by exact raw OCR byte slices, with matching full-page/context-crop OCR and direct same-printing native image corroboration. All other words, punctuation and source LF boundaries remain unchanged.
